items.title: How much meeting time does DACI actually save as the group grows?
items.description: Using the exact numbers from L3 (45-minute consensus meetings needing one extra meeting per 4 stakeholders, versus a fixed 4-person DACI decision meeting at 20 minutes plus a 2-minute summary for everyone else), drag the number of stakeholders. At 8 stakeholders, this reproduces L3's verified 720 vs. 88 person-minutes exactly.
items.compute: const n = params.stakeholderCount; const meetings = Math.ceil(n / 4); const consensusMinutes = n * meetings * 45; const decisionGroup = Math.min(4, n); const informed = Math.max(0, n - decisionGroup); const daciMinutes = decisionGroup * 20 + informed * 2; return { consensusMinutes, daciMinutes };
